sentences.text: first information statement of Annamma.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused married CW-1 on 15-06-1992.
After the marriage, the accused have subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty.

On 19-09-2021 at about 5.30 p.m., the accused assaulted CW-1 with his hands on her left eye and when she tried to escape, the accused held her hand and bitten her little finger on her right hand, causing injury to her and threatened her with dire consequences and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.164/2021 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and was  3  C.C.No.19562/2022 enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.

sentences.text: In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.
The statement of accused No.1 as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C. is not recorded as there were no incriminating material in the evidence against the accused.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 323, 506 of IPC.?
 4  C.C.No.19562/2022  2) what order?
 8.
My finding to the above points are as under:-
Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Annamma.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused Annamma vs Ramanjaneyalu on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27257445/
3 was performed on 19-09-2021 and deposed after the marriage,
accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never assaulted her and threatened to kill her. PW-1
deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1  5  C.C.No.19562/2022 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused Annamma vs Ramanjaneyalu on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27257445/
4 beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 504 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
